source: A {0} in a key splits it into a path: {1} is {2} inside {3}. In a nested file it is {4}, in a flat file {5}. Set {6} for another separator, or to {7} when keys are whole sentences, such as {8} in Laravel, i18next with {9}, or gettext:
text: 鍵中的 {0} 會將其拆成路徑：{1} 是 {3} 內的 {2}。在巢狀檔案中是 {4}，在扁平檔案中是 {5}。可設定 {6} 來使用其他分隔符號；當鍵是完整句子時（例如 Laravel 中的 {8}、搭配 {9} 的 i18next，或 gettext），則設為 {7}：
